$comment: Normative machine source for the ERC-TRUST kernel, version 2. Every generated artifact under spec/generated, sdk/src/kernel-v2.ts, and vectors/conformance-v2.json is derived from this file by scripts/generate-normative-kernel.mjs. Hand edits to generated files are rejected by the generator check mode.

status.stage: normative kernel frozen for the successor candidate; native endpoint and ERC-3643 profile adapter wired; formal mapping and runtime evidence pending
status.note: This file defines the common wire format that the native token and the ERC-3643 adapter profile both implement. Both endpoints under implementation/ consume the generated copy of this kernel (decisions 08 and 09). Conformance of either endpoint is established only by the evidence lanes, never by this file.

domain.description: Every command, binding, root, and receipt preimage starts with this domain constant. A request whose domain field differs MUST revert with TrustInvalidCommand reason 1.

ActionKind.description: The six typed regulatory actions. Values are part of the ABI and MUST NOT be reordered. The order is the canonical order of the shipped kernel version 1 SDK and vectors.

ReversalKind.description: The three reversals. They are a separate type from ActionKind; a reversal is never a new regulatory action.

ReceiptKind.description: Receipt discriminator. NONE (zero) is reserved for an absent receipt and MUST NOT appear in a stored receipt.

BindingKind.description: The four bound external dependencies, in dependency-root order.

AssessmentOutcome.description: Outcome classes. The wire value is the first return word of the bound dependency interface.

Lifecycle.description: Action record lifecycle. CANCELLED from kernel version 1 is removed: no on-chain prepared authorization exists in this kernel, so nothing can be cancelled (see decisions/01-delegation-and-cancellation.md).

CasePhase.description: Case lifecycle phase reported by caseRecord().

CaseFamily.description: The command family that opened the case. A case is bound to one family for its whole life.

ActionRequest.description: Typed action command. 20 static words; calldata length for a single-parameter call is 4 + 640 = 644 bytes. Fields encode, hash, and appear in calldata in the order listed in fields.

fields.name: domain
fields.meaning: MUST equal domain.keccak256

fields.name: actionId
fields.meaning: MUST equal hashes.actionId over this request with actionId zeroed

fields.name: subject
fields.meaning: regulatory subject; MUST NOT be zero

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: account debited by a transfer action; equals subject for FREEZE, RESTRICT, SEIZE and for direct dispositions

fields.name: destination
fields.meaning: account credited by a disposition; zero for FREEZE and RESTRICT; equals custodian for SEIZE

fields.name: custodian
fields.meaning: SEIZE only; zero otherwise

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: FREEZE: absolute frozen target; RESTRICT: MUST be zero; transfers: exact command amount

fields.name: caseId
fields.meaning: regulatory case; MUST NOT be zero

fields.name: dependencyRoot
fields.meaning: MUST equal the endpoint's current dependencyState().dependencyRoot

fields.name: dependencyEpoch
fields.meaning: MUST equal the endpoint's current dependencyState().dependencyEpoch

fields.name: provenanceCommitment
fields.meaning: commitment to the legal basis; MUST NOT be zero; not a claim that the basis is valid

fields.name: settlementCommitment
fields.meaning: LIQUIDATE only; zero otherwise

fields.name: proceedsCommitment
fields.meaning: LIQUIDATE only; zero otherwise

fields.name: entitlementCommitment
fields.meaning: RECOVER only; zero otherwise

fields.name: authorityRef
fields.meaning: authority identifier whose current account MUST be the caller

fields.name: authorityEpoch
fields.meaning: MUST equal the authority's current epoch

fields.name: nonce
fields.meaning: consumed once under (authorityRef, authorityEpoch, nonce)

fields.name: validAfter
fields.meaning: inclusive lower bound on block.timestamp

fields.name: validBefore
fields.meaning: inclusive upper bound on block.timestamp; MUST be nonzero and not below validAfter

ReversalRequest.description: Typed reversal command. 12 static words; calldata length is 4 + 384 = 388 bytes. Fields encode, hash, and appear in calldata in the order listed in fields.

fields.name: domain
fields.meaning: MUST equal domain.keccak256

fields.name: reversalId
fields.meaning: MUST equal hashes.reversalId over this request with reversalId zeroed

fields.name: actionId
fields.meaning: the applied action being reversed

fields.name: dependencyRoot
fields.meaning: MUST equal the current dependencyState().dependencyRoot

fields.name: dependencyEpoch
fields.meaning: MUST equal the current dependencyState().dependencyEpoch

fields.name: provenanceCommitment
fields.meaning: commitment to the legal basis of the reversal; MUST NOT be zero

Receipt.description: Stored and returned by receipt(commandId). Every field except receiptHash is a receipt hash preimage input in this order, prefixed by the domain constant.

fields.name: commandId
fields.meaning: actionId or reversalId

fields.name: commandKind
fields.meaning: ActionKind value (0 to 5) when receiptKind is ACTION; ReversalKind value (0 to 2) when receiptKind is REVERSAL; any other combination is invalid

fields.name: parentCommandId
fields.meaning: zero for ACTION receipts; the reversed actionId for REVERSAL receipts

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: ACTION: request.source; REVERSAL of SEIZE: the custodian; other reversals: the subject

fields.name: destination
fields.meaning: ACTION: effective destination (custodian for SEIZE); RELEASE: the declared prior holder; UNFREEZE and UNRESTRICT: the subject

fields.name: dependencyRoot
fields.meaning: the root the command was validated against

fields.name: assessmentEvidence
fields.meaning: profile-defined commitment to the bound dependency responses consumed by the assessment; the profile MUST document its preimage

fields.name: preState
fields.meaning: profile-defined observation commitment taken immediately before the state effect; the profile MUST document its preimage

fields.name: postState
fields.meaning: profile-defined observation commitment taken immediately after the state effect

fields.name: externalCommitment
fields.meaning: LIQUIDATE: keccak256(abi.encode(settlementCommitment, proceedsCommitment)); RECOVER: entitlementCommitment; every other action and every reversal: zero

fields.name: receiptHash
fields.meaning: hashes.receiptHash over the preceding fields

ActionRecord.description: Returned by actionRecord(actionId). Implementation record; not a hash preimage.

fields.name: priorAmount
fields.meaning: FREEZE: absolute frozen target before this action

fields.name: priorFlag
fields.meaning: RESTRICT: restriction flag before this action

fields.name: commandHash
fields.meaning: hashes.commandHash of the completed request

fields.name: evidenceHash
fields.meaning: equals Receipt.assessmentEvidence

fields.name: headActionId
fields.meaning: the case's currently live effect head (overlay families) or active custody action (CUSTODY); zero when TERMINAL or NONE

fields.name: generation
fields.meaning: monotonic per-case effect generation

ProfileDescriptor.description: Returned by trustProfile(). A declaration about the endpoint, not proof of conformance.

fields.name: profileId
fields.meaning: one of profiles.*.profileId

fields.name: standardVersion
fields.meaning: MUST equal domain.standardVersion

fields.name: actionMask
fields.meaning: bit i set only when ActionKind i is implemented with the complete semantics; a Full profile reports 0x3f

fields.name: reversalMask
fields.meaning: bit i set only when ReversalKind i is implemented; a Full profile reports 0x07

fields.name: underlyingToken
fields.meaning: zero for a native endpoint; the wrapped or adapted token for a profile endpoint

fields.name: manifestHash
fields.meaning: profile-defined commitment to the endpoint's topology and evidence version

fields.name: full
fields.meaning: MUST be computed from the live topology and dependency state, never stored as a constant true

encoding.rule: abi.encode of the listed items in order; a struct encodes as the static tuple of its fields in the order listed in its fields array; every item occupies one 32-byte word (addresses and narrow integers are left-padded with zero bytes; enums are their uint8 value)
encoding.canonicality: The preimage is the canonical ABI encoding. An endpoint MUST reject calldata that is not the canonical encoding of the declared static tuple (wrong length, dirty high bits in narrow integer or address words, enum values outside the declared range). Therefore the canonical encoding and the received calldata bytes coincide for every accepted command. That rejection is a plain revert with no typed error and no reason code: it is a decoding failure of the wire format, not a kernel outcome, and it consumes nothing.
encoding.endpoint: endpoint(address) is the address of the conformance endpoint that executes the command: the token for the native profile, the adapter for a profile endpoint. It is the address a caller invokes, so for a proxy-fronted endpoint it is the proxy address, never the implementation address. In Solidity it is address(this) of the executing contract.
encoding.chainId: chainId(uint256) is the EIP-155 chain identifier of the chain the endpoint is deployed on (block.chainid in Solidity).
encoding.signatures: A canonical function signature is the function name followed by the parenthesized comma-separated canonical parameter types with no spaces. A struct parameter is written as the parenthesized comma-separated list of its field types in fields order; enum fields are uint8. Return types, parameter names, and mutability do not participate. The selector is the first four bytes of keccak256 of the signature.

actionId.rule: keccak256 of the preimage. The request's actionId field MUST equal this value.

commandHash.rule: keccak256. Used as the command digest passed to bound dependencies and stored in ActionRecord.commandHash.

reversalId.rule: keccak256. The request's reversalId field MUST equal this value.

reversalHash.rule: keccak256. Command digest of the reversal.

bindingHash.rule: keccak256. Per-dependency binding of the native profile. Other profiles define their own per-dependency binding but MUST feed the dependency root the same way.

dependencyRoot.rule: keccak256. Ordered by BindingKind. A profile without a given dependency kind uses bytes32(0) in that slot and MUST say so in its manifest. Every rebind of any kind changes the root and increments dependencyEpoch by exactly one.

receiptHash.rule: keccak256 of 17 words. The value MUST equal the execute return value, the stored Receipt.receiptHash, and the receiptHash argument of the final applied event.

nonceKey.rule: keccak256. Reported in TrustReplay when a nonce is reused.

interface.name: IERCTrustKernel

erc165.rule: XOR of the selectors of every function listed below. The inherited supportsInterface(bytes4) selector is excluded. A conforming endpoint MUST return true for this identifier and false for 0xffffffff.

errors.name: TrustRejected
errors.meaning: a completed assessment denied the command; reason in class 100

errors.name: TrustOperationalFailure
errors.meaning: a required dependency or upstream call was unavailable, malformed, stale, or inconsistent; reason in class 200, 300, or 400

errors.name: TrustReplay
errors.meaning: key is the commandId or the nonceKey that was already consumed

errors.name: TrustInvalidCommand
errors.meaning: domain, identifier, time, epoch, binding, shape, case, or reversal precondition failed; reason in class 1

errors.name: TrustTerminal
errors.meaning: the case is TERMINAL; no action or reversal is accepted

interface.eventOrder: Required ERC-20 and ERC-7943 effect events precede the applied event. The applied event is the final log the endpoint emits for the command. A reverted command leaves no persistent log.

IERCTrustNativeRoute.description: Native profile only. Same-transaction exact-use route for the sensitive ERC-7943 selectors. Not part of the kernel interface identifier.

ITrustBoundDependency.description: Native profile dependency boundary. Read-only. The endpoint MUST classify a revert, a return of any length other than 128 bytes, an outcome word above 2, a command echo mismatch, or a binding echo mismatch as OPERATIONAL_FAILURE.
ITrustBoundDependency.operationEncoding: operation is the ActionKind value for actions and 0x80 | ReversalKind value for reversals
ITrustBoundDependency.failureCodes: 200 when the bound runtime code has changed, 201 when the configuration digest has changed, 202 when the call reverts, returns a length other than 128 bytes, or returns an outcome word above 2, 203 when the command echo or the binding echo mismatches, 204 when the dependency itself reports OPERATIONAL_FAILURE

common: actionId or reversalId == the derived identifier (reason 2)
dependencyRoot == current root and dependencyEpoch == current epoch (reason 5)
provenanceCommitment != 0, and for action requests subject != 0 and caseId != 0 (reason 6)

FREEZE.amount: > current absolute frozen target of subject (reason 12 otherwise)

RESTRICT.state: the subject has no live RESTRICT head owned by this case; a second RESTRICT in its own case is rejected with reason 13, and a live RESTRICT head owned by another case is rejected with reason 10 (CT-7)

SEIZE.amount: > 0 and available without consuming custody backing of another case (reason 8 when custody backing would be consumed)

CONFISCATE.amount: > 0; on the direct path the amount MUST be available without consuming custody backing of another case (reason 8 when custody backing would be consumed)
CONFISCATE.path: direct when the case has no active custody (then source == subject); custody disposition when the case has active custody (then source == custodian, subject == declared prior holder, amount == encumbered amount)

reversal.pairing: UNFREEZE only for an applied FREEZE, RELEASE only for an applied SEIZE, UNRESTRICT only for an applied RESTRICT (reason 7)
reversal.currentEffect: the referenced action MUST be the subject's live head for its overlay family, or the case's active custody for RELEASE (reason 11; reason 8 when the custody record does not match)

reasonBinding.6: any per-action field rule below that is not given its own code
reasonBinding.7: reversal kind does not pair with the original action
reasonBinding.8: custody record missing, active when it must not be, or not matching
reasonBinding.9: entitlement commitment missing or already consumed
reasonBinding.11: referenced action is not the subject's live head or the case's active custody
reasonBinding.12: FREEZE target not strictly greater than the current target
reasonBinding.13: no state change (second RESTRICT in its own case)

shapeRules.appliesTo: common rules apply to every request; a rule that names a field applies only to requests that have that field

caseTransitions.description: Machine-readable case state table. Each case is opened by its first applied command and is bound to that command's family. A subject has at most one live head per overlay family across all cases.

rules.guard: subject has no live FREEZE head
subject's live FREEZE head belongs to this case and amount > current target (reason 12 when not greater)

rules.from: NONE or OPEN of another case
rules.guard: subject's live FREEZE head belongs to a different open case
referenced action is the live head (reason 11 otherwise)
rules.to: OPEN(FREEZE) if the popped head's parent belongs to this case, else TERMINAL

rules.guard: subject has no live RESTRICT head

rules.from: NONE or OPEN of another case
rules.guard: subject's live RESTRICT head belongs to a different open case
referenced action is the live head (reason 11 otherwise)

rules.effect: return encumbered amount to declared prior holder, close custody
rules.guard: referenced SEIZE is the case's active custody (reason 11 or 8 otherwise)
source == custodian, subject == declared prior holder, amount == encumbered amount (reason 8 otherwise)
source == subject and the case has no prior command

crossCase: A disposition in one case does not clear an overlay owned by another case; the overlay remains live and its frozen target saturates at the current balance when observed.
Custody records are per case; several custody cases may encumber the same source, each with its own backing.

reasonClasses.description: uint16 reason registry. Classes are normative; an implementation MAY add codes inside a class but MUST NOT reuse a listed code with a different meaning.

native-full.dependencies: four read-only ITrustBoundDependency bindings, one per BindingKind; assessment and execution use the same current binding
native-full.route: IERCTrustNativeRoute; raw setFrozenTokens and forcedTransfer calls fail
native-full.authority: direct: the current account registered for authorityRef, which MAY be a contract; no delegation surface
native-full.observationPreimage: documented by the implementation together with its runtime identity

erc3643-verified-full.dependencies: sealed token runtime identity, Identity Registry, Compliance; the dependency root binds the sealed topology and the epoch increments on every reseal
erc3643-verified-full.onboarding: fresh zero-state seal or exact import manifest; any other initial state is Partial or Unsupported
erc3643-verified-full.full: computed live from the sealed topology; never a stored constant

nonclaims: A receipt proves the on-chain transition and the committed inputs. It does not prove that the authority had legal power or that any policy, identity, settlement, proceeds, entitlement, ownership, or legal assertion is true.
This kernel does not standardize a delegation registry, signature scheme, identity system, policy language, settlement engine, proxy, or migration.
Conformance of this machine source does not establish conformance of any implementation until that implementation's exact source, compiler, and runtime are bound to it.

vectors.fixture: vectors/conformance-v2.json is generated from this schema. Every value in it is reproducible from this file: identifiers by the hash rules above, calldata as selector followed by the canonical encoding.
vectors.negativeFieldBinding: NEG-FIELD-BINDING lists, for the ACTION-FREEZE request, one mutation per bound field: the mutated field name, its original value, and its mutated value are recorded next to the derived identifier so a reader can recompute each identifier without guessing the mutation.
vectors.scenarios: Every action and reversal vector is an independent scenario evaluated against the same initial fixture state; the file is not a single execution trace. In particular the SEIZE case is closed by RELEASE in one scenario and by the custody-disposition CONFISCATE in another, and those two are mutually exclusive on chain. The fixture does not model the authority registry, so the vectors fix authority epochs (1, and 3 for the custody disposition) without asserting that they are current; reason 4 is not exercised by these vectors.
